observations.name: v1.5.0
observations.title: v1.5.0
observations.body:
## What Changed

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Base Sepolia**: Operators must upgrade to this release by October 21 at 18:00:00 UTC for the Denim hardfork. See [here](https://docs.base.org/upgrades/denim/overview) for more information.
>
> `--enable-experimental-validity-transactions` has been removed as a CLI flag for `base-reth-node`. Validity transactions are enabled by default now that Cobalt is live on every network. Operators must remove the flag from their entrypoint command if it is present, or the node will fail to start.
>
> The default proofs history window (`--proofs-history.window`) has changed from 1,296,000 blocks (about 1 month at 2s blocks) to 6,480,000 blocks (about 15 days at 200ms blocks). Operators who rely on the default and need a different retention period should set the flag explicitly.
>
> **Base Mainnet**: This release is safe for mainnet node operators to upgrade to. Denim is only scheduled on Base Sepolia, so mainnet behavior is unchanged. The mainnet Denim activation will come in a future release.

### base-reth-node
- Denim support (Base Sepolia only)
- Validity transactions are always on, and the experimental flag is removed
- jemalloc is now the default global allocator, and `asm-keccak` and `keccak-cache-global` are enabled by default
- Faster proof generation: parallel witness multiproof prewarming, exact point lookups for proofs state reads, and reuse of RocksDB iterators
- Faster proofs snapshot downloads: parallel resumable range streams, extraction during download, and manifest checksum verification
- Bug fixes and improvements

### base-consensus
- Denim support (Base Sepolia only), including a maximum sequencer drift of 6 hours from Denim onward
- RPC methods that the consensus node does not serve are now forwarded to the execution client
- Bug fixes and improvements

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/base/base/compare/v1.4.2...v1.5.0

## Latest Release

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This release replaces **v1.4.1**, and operators must upgrade to v1.4.2.

## What Changed

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Base Mainnet**: Operators must upgrade to this release by September 30 at 18:00:00 UTC for the Cobalt hardfork. See [here](https://docs.base.org/upgrades/cobalt/overview) for more information.
> 
> Similar to v1.4.0, `--rollup.disable-tx-pool-gossip` has been deprecated as a CLI flag for `base-reth-node`. Operators are required to simply remove it from their entrypoint command if you have it present (only relevant if you're upgrading directly from <= v1.3.x)
>
> If you run a node capable of serving proofs requests, this release now includes support for downloading Proofs v2 snapshots. See [here](https://chain.base.org/snapshots) for the preset. 

### base-reth-node
- Cobalt support for mainnet
- Proofs v2 snapshots support for all networks
- Bug fixes and improvements

### base-consensus
- Cobalt support for mainnet
- Bug fixes and improvements

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/base/base/compare/v1.4.1...v1.4.2

observations.name: v1.3.0
observations.title: v1.3.0
observations.body:
## What Changed

> [!IMPORTANT]
> [Release builds now publish the public node image from this repository as `ghcr.io/base/node`.](https://github.com/base/base#run-a-node) The `base/node` repository, which previously built these container images, will be archived.
>
> The `ghcr.io/base/node-reth` image is also deprecated: use `ghcr.io/base/node` instead.

### base-reth-node
- **Upgrades Reth to v2.5.1** with the release-line history-shard read and Engine API pending-handoff backports.
- **Builder and transaction forwarding improvements**: Batches queued forwarder requests, checks block-build cancellation on every transaction, shares the execution cache with the builder, adds parallel state-root support.
- **Operational improvements**: Publishes `ghcr.io/base/node`, adds Mainnet and Sepolia node environment templates, groups Reth snapshot commands, adds EL peer ban/unban and reachability checks in `basectl`, and keeps one month of history in the full preset.
- Bug fixes and stability improvements.

### base-consensus
- **L1 origin and derivation stability**: Adds separate L1 RPC timeouts, L1 origin RPC metrics, prefetched L1 origin reuse, startup RPC retries, finality preservation across derivation resets, outage reorg coverage, and safer orphan detection.
- **P2P and observability**: Adds consensus-layer P2P reachability checks, EL sync probes, validator-only DA batcher sender overrides, and shadow candidate block metrics.
- Bug fixes and stability improvements.

### Proofs and Tooling
- Adds standalone dispute-game proving workflows and single-Anvil no-Nitro proof stack support.
- Binds proofs to L2-activated upgrade schedules and ProtocolVersions schedule IDs.
- Moves the SP1 SNARK path from Groth16 to PLONK, shares SNARK receipt encoding, emits range witness build metrics, and packages proofs DB data into snapshotter run directories.
- Simplifies the prover stack by removing the legacy gRPC ZK prover service, extracting `zk-utils` and `zk-witness`, and migrating Nitro host worker loops onto `base-proof-worker`.
- Adds ZK benchmark and fork-dispute tooling, plus deterministic advisory benchmark comparison and PR comments.

### Full Changelog
https://github.com/base/base/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0

observations.name: v1.2.0
observations.title: v1.2.0
observations.body:
## What Changed

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Base Mainnet:** Required upgrade and migration by mid August.
> **Base Sepolia:** Highly recommended upgrade and migration.
> **Migration time:** Migrations may take a while, we strongly suggest you start mainnet as soon as possible.
> **V1 Snapshots:** Will be decommissioned over the next few weeks.

### base-reth-node
- **Reth V2 Snapshots** To benefit from V2, you must both update to 1.2.0 and update your database to use v2 storage. You can do this via:
  * **Recommended:** Download a new snapshot `base-reth-node download`. See the [docs](https://docs.base.org/base-chain/node-operators/snapshots) for more information.
  * Migrate your existing V1 data `base-reth-node db migrate-v2`. Note: `migrate-v2` is expected to take **much** longer than `download`. Non-archival nodes are not supported for this command.
- **Upgrades Reth to v2.3.0**
- Bug fixes and stability improvements

### base-consensus
- **Fixed prune node sync**: Nodes can reliably do a pruned node sync from genesis
- Bug fixes and stability improvements
